notes: Tools checked end to end. The assistant no longer shows raw tool markup: a real tool outside this turn's group is simply run, and a made-up one gets one correction. A skill's own tools now always reach the assistant when the skill recognises the request — they were missing on 30% of the ways people ask. Skills also stopped matching unrelated requests: 17 of 59 everyday requests were being given another skill's instructions, such as the Wi-Fi guide for 'turn the volume up'. New: pick a random number, roll a dice, flip a coin. Better routing for Persian requests.
